spec2def(lz32.dll lz32.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# lz32.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/lz32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
add_cargo_module(lz32 lz32-cargo lz32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
add_dependencies(lz32 psdk)
